abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 4. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.
